annotations.title: Gravel, mulch, soil and sand volume calculator

description: Gravel, mulch, soil and sand volume calculator — Landscape and site material quantity: area (rectangle, circle by diameter, triangle, or area in sqft) times depth gives cubic feet, cubic yards and cubic meters, then compaction factor and waste give the order quantity in cubic yards (rounded to the half yard), tons and tonnes from typical densities, bag count, pickup and tandem dump truck loads, and coverage per cubic yard. Materials: gravel, crushed_stone, pea_gravel, river_rock, road_base, decomposed_granite, sand, topsoil, compost, mulch. Params: length and width (ft). Optional: depth (in, default 3; 4 for road base), material (default gravel), shape rect|circle|triangle, area (sqft instead of length/width), density (tons per cu yd override), waste (percent, default 5). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_aggregate
